name: Amygdala (Jev)
description: Digital amygdala: a typed fast judge (Jev) answers questions about each agent step and code chooses the response (proceed, note, proof check, ask, hold, send back). Loads by default but stays dormant until a Jev token exists. Shadow mode by default: it decides and logs and enforces nothing through the judge. Replaces AMYGDALA v3.1 (tinkerclaw-learned-intuition) after cutover.

mode.description: shadow = decide and log, enforce nothing through the judge; enforce = the judge's responses reach the agent through the hooks.

enforceFamilies.description: Families whose notes act while mode is shadow. A note only adds a line to the agent's context; nothing is held or blocked.

sendRealSituations.description: When false, real situations never leave the machine: only synthetic cases reach Jev. The token is read from the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable (needs a restart) or the key file <state dir>/jev/token (picked up without a restart). It is never held in config.

tokenHelpUrl.description: Where to get a Jev token. Shown in the start line and the status; no default.

failClosedOnLevel3.description: When the judge is unreachable, hold danger-level-3 steps instead of letting them proceed. Hard rules always fail closed regardless.

autoLoosen.description: A clean loosening (a question that would hold less) applies itself under the caps and shows up with Undo. Off (the default since 2026-10-25): every loosening waits as a card for the owner, because only the owner loosens a rule. A tightening always applies at once.

explain.description: The WOULD HAVE explainer: a second model words each Jev flag for the owner and suggests a vote.

review.description: After each turn, a second model judges whether each Jev flag of that turn would have helped, from what the agent did next.

ladder.description: Models that judge the flags, first that answers wins. Earned activation counts only the `earned.judge` model's reviews.

earned.description: Progressive activation: a note or send-back rule acts on its own once the judge's reviews over the last `days` show at least `minReviews`, a `minUseful` share useful and at most a `maxHarmful` share harmful. Holds and questions never activate this way.
